typography.headings: font-sans font-bold tracking-tight text-gray-900 (Use Outfit or Manrope). Scale max text-2xl or text-3xl for mobile app feel.
typography.body: font-sans font-medium text-gray-700 (Use IBM Plex Sans or Inter, highly legible at small scales). Keep fonts small to maximize screen real estate.

visual enhancers.border_radius: Extremely curvy. Use rounded-2xl for cards and rounded-full for buttons/icons.
visual enhancers.shadows: Soft, colored shadows for primary actions (shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(0,185,107,0.3)])
visual enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 for sticky headers and floating bars.
visual enhancers.spacing: Dense item grids with p-2 or p-3 to show more items, but generous padding (p-4 to p-6) for outer containers.

component name.FloatingCart: Pill-shaped bottom floating bar (Instamart style) with live price, item count, and Checkout CTA.
component name.OneButton: Central '1' floating action button with pulsing neon green glow. Tap -> Discover Reels, Hold -> AI Bot.
component name.VendorPopUp: Small animated illustration overlay above Proceed to Pay button.
component name.CollapsibleHeader: Header containing Search Bar. On scroll, category icons (Food, Groceries, Shops, Pharmacy, Book it) collapse into the search bar row to save vertical space.
component name.CartTabs: Segmented control at the top of the Cart page: [ Cart | One Saver ].
component name.DiscoverReels: Instagram-style 3-column dense grid. Tapping an item opens a fullscreen swipable reel.
component name.AIBotSheet: Bottom sheet triggered by long-press on '1' button. Conversational UI for meal/catalogue recommendations (e.g. 'gym for bulk').

grids.DiscoverGrid: grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 (Instagram explore page style)
grids.ProductGrid: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 p-3 (dense product layout)

layouts.app_shell: Mobile-first, constrained max-width (max-w-md mx-auto relative h-screen bg-white overflow-hidden).
layouts.header: Sticky top-0 z-40 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md pt-4 pb-2 px-4 transition-all. Logo shrunk. Category strip scales down and moves inline with search on scroll.
layouts.cart_page: Top sticky tabs (Cart / One Saver). Scrollable item list. Bottom floating 'Proceed to pay' button.
layouts.vendor_illustration_placement: Absolute positioned bottom-full mb-2 left-4 (just above the Pay button), sliding up on item add.

motion.OneButton_Glow: framer-motion animate={{ boxShadow: ['0px 0px 0px 0px rgba(0,185,107,0.8)', '0px 0px 20px 10px rgba(0,185,107,0)'] }} transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 1.5 }}
motion.Add_To_Cart: Trajectory animation: when clicking '+' on a product, a miniature version of the product flies in an arc into the bottom floating cart.
motion.Vendor_PopUp: Slide up from bottom (y: 20 to 0) with gentle spring, delay 0.2s, pop-in text bubble ('Raju Bhaiya packed your veggies').
motion.Header_Collapse: Smooth height interpolation and layout transition using framer-motion layoutId for category items moving up.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #00B96B passes minimum 3:1 APCA. Use #0A0A0A for all typography.
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements (e.g., '1-button-tap', '1-button-hold', 'add-to-cart-btn', 'floating-cart').
accessibility.touch_targets: Ensure all curvy buttons have minimum 44x44px touch area.

3d libraries.usage: Use Framer Motion for UI animations and 2D-plane interactions (Reels swipe, floating cart, glow). The 3D category icons are static image assets provided in the media section, styled with drop-shadows to look interactive.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: DO NOT rebuild the app. Update existing JS components in `/app/frontend/src/` incrementally.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Replace the current logo with the provided `logo_1` URL and shrink its container.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement the Header collapse feature: Use framer-motion. On scroll > 50px, transition the 'Food, Groceries, Shops, Pharmacy, Book it' horizontal strip up alongside the search bar, shrinking their icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The 1 Button: Apply continuous pulsing `box-shadow` (green glow). Use `onPress` (or `onClick`) to route to /discover (Reels Grid) and `onLongPress` to open a bottom sheet AI Bot (use Framer Motion drag constraints or standard Dialog).
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Discover Reels: Create a 3-column dense grid of thumbnail rectangles. Tapping one should show a fullscreen video/image view (mock the video with an image).
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Instamart Floating Cart: When cart.length > 0, show a sticky bottom bar (z-50) hovering above the bottom tab nav. Make it pill-shaped (rounded-full). When 'Add' is clicked on a product, animate a small dot flying into the cart.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Cart Page tabs: Add a simple segmented control at the top: 'Cart' and 'One Saver'.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Vendor Animations: On the delivery/checkout screen, watch the cart items. When the screen loads or item is updated, slide up one of the 5 character illustrations (e.g., Raju Bhaiya) from behind the 'Proceed to pay' button with a chat bubble.
instructions_to_main_agent.9: Make all buttons and inputs extremely curvy (`rounded-3xl` or `rounded-full`). Shrink font sizes across the board to create high data density.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this! Build a highly interactive, fluid, app-like frontend. DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific elements. Avoid completely transparent backgrounds for overlays and headers; always use a blur + slight opacity (e.g., bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md). DO NOT center-align all app text; left-align naturally. Use the precise image URLs provided; never use dummyimage.com placeholders. Use `data-testid` on all buttons, links, and interactive elements.
